description: A composed prospecting actor with four modes. enrich_companies resolves identity, firmographics, LinkedIn and social for each domain or company name you supply, and needs no vendor key at all. discover_jobs finds who is hiring for your keywords and resolves the real employer behind each posting, including postings a job board placed on an employer's behalf. find_contacts finds people at the companies you name, with optional email discovery and verification. full runs discovery, enrichment, ICP scoring and then contact discovery, passing only the companies at or above min_icp_score through to the contact stage. Every row comes back flat and Clay ready with per field provenance. Vendor keys are yours: you supply them, those vendors bill you directly, and the per event price covers the actor only. discover_jobs and full require a SerpApi key, which is a different vendor from the Serper key that powers people search. Use it when you need companies, hiring signals, or contacts in one flat table. Do not use it to verify a single email you already have (that is the Work Email Waterfall) or to score a list you already enriched (that is the ICP Fit Scorer). Cost controls: max_results and max_pages bound discovery, target_contacts bounds contacts per company, target_roles skips paid lookups for non-matching contacts, and max_spend_usd caps your own vendor spend. Requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits. Read only: it enriches and discovers, it writes nothing.

bounceban_api_key.description: Your BounceBan key. Second verifier, used for the catch-all case.

brand_voice.description: How the opener should sound. Leave empty and it writes plainly and directly.

claude_api_key.description: Your own Anthropic key, used for position verification and the personalized opener. Both steps are skipped when it is absent. Never stored.

company_concurrency.description: How many companies to work at once. Simultaneous provider calls are this times contact_concurrency; 6 x 3 = 18 sits under the tightest documented provider ceiling. Default: "6".

company_names.description: One name per line. Used when you have a name but no domain.

company_size_max.description: Drop companies above this headcount. Same condition as the minimum.

company_size_min.description: Drop companies below this headcount. Only takes effect once headcount is known, so it applies in full mode and to any discovery row that carried an employee count. Discovery alone does not enrich.

contact_concurrency.description: How many contacts to enrich at once within one company. The email waterfall itself always runs in order. Default: "3".

country.description: Two letter country code for job search, for example us or gb. Default: "us".

deny_tokens.description: Whole words that disqualify a contact even when the title matched a target role, for example product refuses Product Owner and keeps Production Editor. Applies even when no target roles are set.

departments.description: marketing, sales, engineering, product, finance, hr, operations, legal.

domains.description: One domain per line. Used by enrich_companies and find_contacts.

exclude_marketplaces.description: true to drop Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer and similar gig listings. Default: "true".

exclude_staffing.description: true to drop postings from staffing and recruitment agencies. Default: "true".

extra_exclude_names.description: Any company whose name contains one of these is excluded.

extra_marketplaces.description: Additional marketplace names to filter out.

fetch_posting_page.description: true to open the job posting when the description alone does not identify the employer. Slower, and it is what catches a job board posting on an employer's behalf. Default: "true".

findymail_api_key.description: Your Findymail key. First provider in the email waterfall.

icp_preset.description: Which scoring model to apply. "editorial_services" scores for a seller of managed copy editing and proofreading. "generic_b2b" scores on hiring intent, employer resolvability and headcount with no service-specific vocabulary. Default: "editorial_services".

icypeas_api_key.description: Your Icypeas key. Runs on Findymail misses.

include_email.description: true to run the email waterfall. Needs an Icypeas or Prospeo key, which you supply and are billed for directly. Default: "false".

include_social.description: true to resolve Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube alongside LinkedIn. Default: "true".

job_titles.description: Titles to search for when finding contacts.

keywords.description: Roles to search for. Used by discover_jobs and full. Example: copy editor, proofreader, content editor. Default: ["copy editor", "proofreader", "content editor"].

location.description: Optional location filter for job search, for example New York.

lookback_days.description: Drop postings older than this many days. Sent as a string because Clay sends every field as a string. Default: "30".

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The actor's own spend cap for this run, in USD. The run stops before a charge would take its total past this amount, writes one notice row saying so, and keeps every row already charged. Leave it empty for no cap of your own; the maximum cost per run set in Apify is honored either way.

max_pages.description: 1 to 5. Each page is one SerpAPI call, so this is the main cost dial on discovery. Default: "1".

max_results.description: Cap on postings returned per run. Keeps a broad keyword set from running away. Default: "25".

max_spend_usd.description: Stop making paid vendor calls once this much of your own vendor spend (Findymail, Icypeas, Prospeo, BounceBan) is committed, and return everything completed so far. Caps your vendor bills, not the Apify charge for this actor. Leave empty for no cap.

min_icp_score.description: In full mode, only companies scoring at or above this go on to contact discovery. Default 45: at 25 the filter passed every keyword-discovered editorial posting, because 25 is the floor such a posting can score. Default: "45".

mode.description: What to run. enrich_companies resolves identity, firmographics, LinkedIn and social for each company. discover_jobs finds who is hiring for your keywords and resolves the real employer from the job description. find_contacts finds people at each company. full chains all three. Default: "enrich_companies".

new_postings_only.description: true to return only postings not seen in a previous run. Default: "false".

personalize.description: true to write a one or two sentence opener per contact that has an address, referencing something specific about the company. Needs claude_api_key; skipped without it. Default: "true".

previous_run_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD watermark for delta detection when the cross-run cache is unavailable.

prospeo_api_key.description: Your Prospeo key. Runs on the residual after Findymail and Icypeas.

remote_only.description: true to keep only postings flagged remote by the board. Default: "false".

score_icp.description: true to score every row against the ICP rules and tier it A to D. Default: "true".

serpapi_key.description: Your SerpApi key. Required by discover_jobs and full. Distinct from a Serper key: different vendor.

serper_api_key.description: Your Serper.dev key. Powers people search in find_contacts, which is the highest-coverage layer. Without it the free fallback is measurably poor.

signal_taxonomy.description: Override the default signal types. Each entry is an object with type, strength, title_keywords, and optional also_keywords and description_keywords.

skip_cache.description: true to ignore the 7 day cross-run cache and recompute everything. Default: "false".

source_timeout_secs.description: 5 to 120. A source that exceeds this is marked degraded and the run continues. Default: "30".

target_roles.description: Only enrich contacts whose title plausibly matches one of these roles. Filters after discovery and before any paid email lookup, so a non-matching contact costs nothing. Leave empty to keep every contact the seniority and department filters allow.

verify_email.description: true to verify each address. Needs a BounceBan key. Default: "true".

verify_position.description: true to ask a model whether each contact's title on record is consistent and plausibly current, from the supplied evidence only. Needs claude_api_key; skipped without it. Contacts found on the company's own website are skipped. Default: "true".
